items.title: Mob Morph
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Be a Mob! Morph into all of Minecraft's mobs. Now, you can be whatever one you want! Morph into a creeper, or blast your friends as the wither! Climb walls as a spider or swim through the ocean as a dolphin. Morph into mobs in survival or pick whatever one you want!

+ Updated to ALL mobs up to 1.17
+ Inherit size, abilities, and relationships with other mobs!

items.title: Ice Cave
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: In a frozen biome you may find interesting things, what about a giant cave hidden for hundreds of years? Sounds interesting! Explore its secrets and treasures.

items.title: Candy Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Not even your sugary sweets are safe from these supernatural horrors! When reality glitches where can you hide? Grab your gear and block their otherworldly attacks!

- Includes fourteen sugary yet dangerous candy glitch skins!
- Are you lucky enough to survive when they strike next?

items.title: Red Vs Black Knights
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Knights covered in fancy armor! Fight for glory with neon red eyes, masks, and cool armor. These skins could be great, out on the battlefield in your next PVP match! Maybe you will find yourself a 1v1 and see which color fits you best! These knights would be epic to slay the ender dragon!

- 12 knights!
- 6 black
- 6 red
- 2 free skins!
- By Hourglass Studios

items.title: SKYBLOCK!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
Build your own custom skyblock adventure with this new experience to the mode you know and love! Combine settings to create a new map every time and create the skyblock experience of your dreams! 
+ 7 starting island options
+ 5 custom modes
+ Secret special settings
+ Custom villager shop
+ 35+ possible skyblock combinations
+ Parkour
+ Play alone or with friends

items.title: One Block Skyblock!
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Each time you break the block below, it's replaced by another one. Use the items to expand your island and buy Cubed Coins. With these coins you can unlock new islands with a unique one block that you can use to collect new items! This is the renewed and improved One Block Challenge!

+Mob spawns!
+Lucky bonus chests!
+Custom Nether skyblock!
+Infinity spawnable islands!

items.title: MC GAMERS
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description: Time the be the ultimate gamer! Choose any of these awesome gamer skins for your next Minecraft world!

items.title: Pirates
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
Set sail upon the open seas and take all the gold! Be the Captain of your own crew, navigate the waters, or ready the cannons. There's always a place for you aboard the pirate ship, matey!

+ 12 Seaworthy Skins!
+ 1 FREE Skin: Charles

By FTB

items.title: Virtual Pop Stars
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
Become the biggest pop star in the world! 

- 10 stylish teen skins
- Perfect for musical roleplay
- 1 FREE skin: Ava

By FTB

items.title: Ultimate Creepers
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
With so many cool creepers in this pack, you will have no trouble finding one that you like! Show off this collection of 30 colorful skins, each with cool designs. Wear your favorite and show them off to your friends!
-30 skins 
-2 free

items.title: Space Base
items.creator: Maca Designs
items.description:
Survive in your own flying Space Base! Design this mega base to your own liking and use your custom UFOs to fly around!

- Custom Space Base 
- Live in a HUGE crater
- 7 differently colored UFOs!

items.title: Fries
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
These deep fried, thinly cut, salted potatoes have a lot more character than the average fry. Become a superhero fry - or a wizard, or even just a classic ketchup dipped fry!

+ 7 skins themed around fries.
+ Super random outfits!

items.title: Rat In The Kitchen
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Play this tremendous adventure, make your way round this giant, dirty, pest infested kitchen, fight all kinds of creepy crawly's on your way to the rat boss. Work as a team to collect coins to unlock new pests, buy better armour and weapons. But if your feeling brave you can go it alone.

items.title: Mystical Tree Island
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
A huge tree has been growing on this island for thousands of years. Start your next survival adventure, explore the environment and equip yourself for your next journey!

+Survival Spawn
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Grunge Aesthetic
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Rock out in these stylishly dark grunge outfits!

+ 12 teenage skins
+ Cool clothes

items.title: Teen Heroes
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
You are equipped with the latest trends! These teens are full of life, energy and ready to conquer the world around them!

-1 Free skin included

items.title: Neon Laser Robots
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: These bright neon colored robots are bound to give your game play a new cyberpunk, laser flair. 15 skins with a variety of colors and sci-fi designs. Time to level up in style!

items.title: Halloween Buddies
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Go on a Halloween candy hunt with your buddy! If you want to look cool while collecting candies, these skins are for you!

- 10 Skins
- Perfect for roleplay!
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Bed Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Who needs bed wars when you can have bed mobs? These skins comes with many different designs including Creeper, Enderman, Skeleton, Zombie, and more!

- 8 skins!

Which mob is your favorite?

items.title: Lucky Block Expansion
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Try your luck in Lucky Block Expansion! Open the classic lucky blocks and face exciting outcomes. Will you get lots of diamonds or land in lava?

+ Over 50 good or bad outcomes
+ Includes traps and structures
+ PvP arena
+ Licensed by Levelatics and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Devious Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Some teens are just plain devious sometimes. They're so silly, but yet so cool! I don't know what it is! 

+ 20 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern attire inspired by anime!

items.title: Velvet Demons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
What color comes to mind when we think of the word "demons"? Red, of course! And nothing is more royal and beautiful than the color of red velvet! Velvet demons are here!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Cute and casual attire inspired by red velvet!

items.title: Gods of War
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
War breeds heroes. Heroes become legends. And legends live on. Legends create gods. Will you become a god of war?

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Warrior attire inspired by history!

items.title: Neko Maid Cafe
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Neko neko! What's better than a maid cafe? A cat themed maid cafe! That's right! Cat's are coming to your favorite cafes now!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Cute, feline work attire inspired by maids and butlers!
